data.summary: A machine-readable cryptographic inventory (CBOM, CycloneDX) and a post-quantum migration map for the Zcash repositories in scope, so that a 2027 signature change starts from a complete picture of what cryptography is deployed and where.

data.summary: Cryppit requests $24,500 to make transparent ZEC-source swaps in Vultisig/SwapKit compatible with Zcash v5 transactions and ZIP 244 before and after NU7. The project will define the provider payload contract, implement or coordinate v5 transaction construction, integrate the maintained v5 signing path into Vultisig Android, and publish cross-platform conformance evidence without recreating the Wallet Core primitives covered by a separate pending application.

data.title: ZecLink — Making Zcash Payments Simple and Accessible
data.summary: ZecLink is a Zcash-focused web application that enables users to send and receive ZEC through shareable payment links without requiring the sender to know the recipient's wallet address in advance. We are requesting $40,000 to improve the application's security, transaction reliability, recovery mechanisms, and usability, supporting broader adoption of Zcash.

data.title: {Zcash NU7 Compatibility for Wallet Core}
data.summary: I request $24,000 to harden, independently review and release the existing transparent v5 Wallet Core repair demonstrated through a pinned Vultisig Android integration. The MVP already produces a confirmed payment using mature Regtest inputs; this grant funds the remaining production work and six months of maintenance.

data.title: Zcash Localization Hub RU/UA
data.summary: Localize the 20 highest-impact ZecHub wiki pages into Russian and Ukrainian with a consistent terminology glossary, and run an 8-week bilingual (RU/UA) Zcash ecosystem digest — giving 250 million post-Soviet-market speakers a native-language path into Zcash self-custody and privacy.

data.title: Rypto: Zcash Privacy Content & Amplification Campaign
data.summary: A 6-month content campaign that amplifies Zcash news, tech and tutorials to Rypto’s 30K+ organic followers, putting more eyes on Zcash and building a credible presence as the market turns towards privacy. The aim is to make Zcash the go-to name in privacy conversations and get more people actually using shielded ZEC.

data.title: Lean proof of the GLV recoding and ladder in pasta_curves (part 3 of pasta_curves#174)
data.summary: We have completed a machine-checked Lean proof of the wNAF recoding and the Straus ladder in pasta_curves' GLV scalar multiplication (part 3 of pasta_curves#174), and opened it as a pull request to pasta_curves. This is the code that Orchard's batched trial decryption calls. The recoding is proved against Aeneas' translation of the Rust, and the ladder against a Lean model of it. We request $7,000, paid only if the pasta_curves maintainers accept the proof: $5,500 on…

data.title: {Zcash Durable Payment Outbox}
data.summary: Zcash Durable Payment Outbox is a self-hosted Zallet payout service that preserves a business payment’s identity and saves its final transaction before broadcasting, allowing eligible retries to reuse the recorded transaction. This grant will turn the working regtest MVP into a reviewed release with verified restoration, wallet authority controls, supported recovery and network upgrade qualification.

data.title: Zash: free, open-source Zcash education bot and channel in Spanish
data.summary: Zash (@ZashCash_bot) is a free, open-source Telegram bot that teaches Zcash from scratch to Spanish speakers in Spain and Latin America. This grant turns it into a complete Spanish-language learning path: a public Telegram channel, a peer-reviewed course, wallet walkthroughs and outreach to Spanish-speaking communities.

data.title: {Pasta GLV Scalar Split Assurance: Source-Linked Proofs for Pallas and Vesta}
data.summary: We propose to extend an existing machine-checked Pallas arithmetic MVP into reproducible, source-linked scalar-decomposition proofs for Pallas and Vesta. The project will connect the supported Rust scalar representations and serialization path to the arithmetic guarantees, then publish the proofs, replay tooling and precise coverage documentation.

data.title: Zcash @BlockchainLife 2026
data.summary: You can find a full doc here And a short deck here SANA Labs proposes a measurable Zcash ecosystem growth initiative at Blockchain Life Dubai on December 1–2, 2026, combining an 8 sqm booth with guided shielded-payment demonstrations, developer onboarding, and targeted B2B meetings for a +15000 attendee being one of the biggest Web3 events in the world. The $35,000 grant will fund preparation, on-site execution, and a 30-day follow-up program, with public KPI reporting and…

data.title: zreceipt: payment disclosures for shielded Zcash (ZIP 311)
data.summary: zreceipt lets the sender of a shielded Zcash payment prove one payment (its amount, recipient and memo) to an auditor, bank or tax office with a link, without revealing anything else in their wallet; it works on Zcash mainnet today. This grant adds the spend-authority proof that draft ZIP 311 requires for a complete payment disclosure, showing that the disclosure was made by whoever controlled the funds that paid: for Sapling following the ZIP, and for Orchard and Ironwood…

data.title: Develop a Go interface to state-of-the-art Zcash light-wallet tech
data.summary: We’re building a Zcash light-wallet Go module: an idiomatic Go interface over an FFI binding to librustzcash, with function signatures and lifecycle management that Go programmers will find familiar. The module we develop will be importable by any Go consumer. This is, roughly speaking, an analogue of zcash/zcash-android-wallet-sdk We'll also implement a command-line JSON-RPC wallet program, to provide additional utility and as a demonstration of functionality.…

data.title: Zcash 中文入门包 / Zcash Chinese Onboarding Pack
data.summary: A practical Simplified Chinese onboarding pack for Zcash that does not re-translate the existing zh wiki: a shielded-wallet tutorial with screenshots, 3 long-form Chinese articles, and a durable EN–ZH glossary artifact aligned with the live ZecHub glossary/menu native-review bounty. All open-licensed and contributed upstream to ZecHub.

data.title: Zcash RPC Streaming Redaction Audit
data.summary: An eight-week independent research project to measure when known sensitive literals survive chunked logging of Zcash RPC-shaped messages, and to compare exact streaming redaction with buffer-then-redact baselines. I will release synthetic fixtures, a reference adapter and a reproducible report under MIT.

data.title: Zcash Early Builders Lab (ZEBL) Cape Town
data.summary: Zcash Early Builders Lab (ZEBL) Cape Town is an interactive 2-day hands-on workshop and mini-hackathon designed to teach high school upperclassmen and early university students zero-knowledge cryptography, digital financial literacy, and privacy-preserving development. By blending hands-on zero-knowledge cryptography exercises with guided mentorship, the lab transforms young tech enthusiasts into active open-source contributors and privacy champions.

data.title: Zocial World — Privacy-First Social, Learning and Collaboration Platform for Zcash
data.summary: Zocial World is an open-source, browser-based 3D social world for the Zcash ecosystem, combining community interaction, education, events, project discovery and privacy-preserving ZEC usage in one shared environment. A public beta is already live, and this grant will fund the next phase of development focused on reliability, Learning Valley, Watch Hall, contributor collaboration, original world content, security and infrastructure.

data.title: Interoperable FROST co-signing for shielded ZEC: open specs and a reference implementation
data.summary: Consumer FROST 2-of-3 for shielded ZEC is arriving in several wallets at once (Zkool already ships it; NoirWallet and OpenPGP Wallet published designs the same week), each with its own signing protocol and backup format. This grant produces an open specification for the QR messages between a coordinator and a co-signer and for FROST share backups, including a profile with no recovery phrase, plus a standalone Rust crate, test vectors and a working reference implementation…

data.title: Zecboat: Wake v1, a custom Halo 2 circuit for note lineage
data.summary: Wake-v1 is a custom Halo 2 circuit for note lineage: it lets the user who receives a layer two zcash shielded asset check, from the chain, that the note in their hand descends from the issuer's original note. It needs no trusted setup and no consensus change. The proofs travel inside the transfer itself, so no server stands between the sender and receiver. Wake-v1 ships in Zecboat 0.7.1-beta today; this grant takes it through an independent review to a wallet that can say…

data.title: CENTIREINGS Zcash Market Segmentation & Comparative Intelligence
data.summary: CENTIREINGS proposes to extend an existing 20-asset quantitative market benchmark into a Zcash-focused comparative intelligence resource. The project will position ZEC within a broader crypto-market segmentation, test the stability of that classification using post-period evidence, and publish a reproducible ZEC Market Segmentation Map for the Zcash community.

data.title: Skyhook and ESMASTe: Cross-chain Bridging, Messaging and Execution Layer
data.summary: Our research on the Skyhook Bridge enables programmable payment recognition and expectation in Turing-complete correspondent chains for cross-chain value transfer directly in the shielded pool trustlessly, enabling atomic swaps, decentralised liquidity bridging, and countless extensions.

data.title: Zcash Private Receive Bridge
data.summary: Zcash Private Receive Bridge is an open-source local service designed to reduce disclosure of wallet-selected confirmed transaction lookups to remote lightwallet servers. It downloads public block intervals and the full transactions referenced by their compact blocks, then serves supported wallets through a local gRPC cache without selective upstream fallback.

data.title: Zcash BuildPath India: Four-City Developer Onboarding Pilot
data.summary: We request $17,600 for a 14-week, four-city developer onboarding pilot in Bhopal, Indore, Delhi and Noida that moves the same participants from Zcash fundamentals through tested integrations, build days and 30-day follow-up. Zcash receives reusable open-source learning material, independently reproducible participant prototypes and an honest record of where builders succeed or get stuck, supported by our existing Veil prototype rather than claims of adoption we have not yet…

round.votingSystem: Shielded, coin-weighted voting on the Valar Group vote chain through the ZODL, Zkool and Vizor wallets, with the snapshot at block 3,485,940. Ballots are encrypted and tallied by ten validators with a seven-of-ten threshold. FPF confirmed on October 2 that Q3 required voters to explicitly select Abstain; it was not a default.

rule.text: FPF’s current counting rule: all options, including explicit Abstain, count toward the 420,000 ZEC minimum. Accept must exceed both Reject options combined; Abstain is excluded from the majority. ZIP 1016 does not explicitly define Abstain’s treatment. FPF clarified the Q3 rule on October 2, 2026 and will state it in the Q4 voting announcement.

participationConfirmedBy.covers: Explicit Abstain counts toward the minimum; Q3 did not default to Abstain. Q4 counting rules will be stated in its voting announcement.

data.units: ZEC. The vote chain's total_value counts units of 0.125 ZEC and is divided by 8; an option with no ZEC omits it. approveShare is Accept over Accept plus both Reject options. quorumMet counts every option toward the 420,000 ZEC minimum, Abstain included; quorumMetWithoutAbstain counts only the ZEC for or against.
